title: How To Do Bodyweight Squats
hook: The bodyweight squat is the first leg exercise you should learn, and you don't need any equipment to do it.
body: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart. Sit back like there's a chair behind you, keep your chest up, and go down until your thighs are parallel with the floor. Then stand back up. If you're a beginner and can't do one yet, squat down to a real chair and then stand back up. Do your squats slowly on a timer: 30 seconds on and 30 seconds off. Once they get easy, hold a kettlebell at your chest to make them more challenging.
